title: GET /report-subscriptions – 200 response
description: The subscriptions of the caller's sites, whoever the subscriber is; ?site_id= or ?user_id= limits them. Supervisor token, or the site phone's device token with an X-Acting-User header (then only on the phone's site). Error responses use api/error.json.

next_cursor.description: Absent or null: the list is complete. A string: the server pages this list (at most 500 items per page); request the next page with ?cursor=<next_cursor> and the same filters, and merge the pages. The server may start paging without a new schema version, so a client must follow it.
